Use `snl entry-package create` to publish a new Entry Package only after its draft passes the corresponding check.

### Command path
`entry-package/create` is the canonical transport-neutral command. The shell adapter is `snl entry-package create`; an Agent/MCP adapter submits the same operation object instead of reconstructing shell text.

### Operation request
```json
{"protocol":"snl.operation/v1","command":"entry-package/create","root":"/absolute/workspace","arguments":{"value":{}}}
```
Every adapter accepts exactly this semantic request. Unknown argument keys are rejected. The CLI accepts `--root` and `--json` globally and emits one complete JSON document followed by a newline. No upsert semantics. Existing identity is a conflict (exit 1) with zero byte changes.

### Success result
A successful call exits `0` and returns `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":true,"command":"entry-package/create","data":...,"diagnostics":[]}`. `data.entity` is the canonical readback including exact identity and new revision.

### Failure and exit semantics
Domain rejection (invalid data, not-found, conflict, or validation errors) exits `1`. Invocation, input I/O, unsupported workspace/schema, lock acquisition, and runtime failures exit `2`. Failure stdout under `--json` is exactly one `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":false,"command":"entry-package/create","error":{"code":"<stable-code>","message":"<actionable text>","details":...,"retryable":false}}`; no stack trace or prose contaminates stdout.

### State and concurrency
Mutating. Validate proposed complete state, acquire the shared lock, reject identity collision, install durably, update every membership/index authority, and read back. Revisions, cursors, checked digests, and workspace revisions are opaque tokens. After success, canonical readback and whole-workspace validation must observe the published state.
